title: Black Truffle Gnocchi
description: Truffle oil, truffle salt, and shaved truffles combine to create a Northern Italian gnocchi dish with a rich, buttery Grana Padano cheese sauce.
ingredients: 1 cup finely grated Grana Padano cheese
1 tablespoon Grana Padano cheese, or to taste
black sea salt and ground black pepper, to taste

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook gnocchi in boiling water until they float to the top, 2 to 4 minutes. Drain gnocchi, reserving 1/4 cup cooking water.

Bring shallots, wine, and garlic to a boil in a large sauté pan. Reduce heat and simmer until reduced by half, 5 to 7 minutes. Add butter and cook until melted. Stir in truffle oil until well distributed. Add reserved 1/4 cup cooking water, gnocchi, and 1 cup Grana Padano cheese; toss until evenly coated and cook over medium-low heat until warmed through and cheese is melted. Add black pepper and black truffle salt; toss well.
Transfer to a large serving bowl. Top with shaved truffles and 1 tablespoon Grana Padano cheese. Season with black sea salt and black pepper.
